name: round-0-plain-yamnet
recognition_input: original stereo averaged to mono; no side input or voice separation
threshold_provenance: Reuse existing step-1 proposal thresholds unchanged, before opening test answers. Not tuned for caption accuracy.
deduplication: One emission attempt per consecutive above-threshold run for each label/direction. Center-suppressed candidates are ignored; capacity-blocked attempts are discarded.
caption_timestamp: End of the first window that emits the caption; zero padding is causal at the final tail only.
matching: Maximum-cardinality one-to-one same-label matching, absolute onset difference <= 1 second.
false_caption_definition: No annotated game-sound onset of any label within 1 second. Also report all unmatched captions/min, including wrong labels and duplicates.
primary_targets: Non-centered labeled game events; additionally report all directions, including intentionally hidden centered sounds.
context_policy: All quiet/talking/music slices unavailable until manual context annotation is complete. Absence of spans is not evidence of quiet.
test_scope: Four held-out Valorant clips and one unseen CS clip only. Final lab clip remains closed. No training.
